issues.reason: "copper" is a noun sitting in front of another noun, not a material adjective, so Compound concepts' determined rule bars the modifier genus exactly as it bars `steel_beam` -> `steel` (the exposed material case is the adjective `wooden`), and the atom additionally asserts the falsehood that a copper cauldron is a kind of copper.

defect_summary: The compliant form emits only the head genus `(Inheritance copper_cauldron cauldron)` and no modifier genus at all — the noun-modifier bar leaves `copper` inside the fused symbol.
notes: Everything else conforms: the multi-word name as one opaque symbol plus a separate kind atom, `Agent` on the stative transitive "holds", and group + `Cardinality 3` with the head genus on the counted object.
